newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pan United sees poorer 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: Pan United sees poorer 1997 results.

text.p: Pan-United Corp Ltd said on Friday it expected its 1997 results to be less favourable than 1996 due mainly to difficult market conditions in the shiprepair industry.
It said in a statement accompanying its results that its shipyard would be kept busy with the construction of two oil product tankers, expected to be delivered in the first half of 1998.
The group's diversification into industrial and trading activities would be maintained in 1997, it said.

The investment in a cement plant in Shandong, China was expected to contribute modestly to the group's profit in 1997, but this could be offset by continuing difficulties in its ductile cast iron pipe plant, Pan-United said.
It said its port project in Changshu, China was expected to start operations in the first half of this year and incur start-up costs.
